The '''Kadlo Talisman''' was a small idol from the reign of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Kadlo]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. It was stolen by thieves from the [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] where it lay, who were later in turn killed by mutinous crewmen of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cov (Duros)|Cov]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Unknowing of this, Cov hired several individuals to retrieve the Talisman.
